varm plot theme and palette

Source: R/theme.R
theme_varm.Rd

theme_varm() is the single theme used by every ggplot2::autoplot() method in varm: black-and-white panel, dashed major grid, no strip background, legend at the bottom. varm_palette() returns colours from the colour-blind safe Okabe-Ito palette.

Usage

theme_varm(base_size = 11)

varm_palette(n = 8L)

Arguments

base_size

base font size, passed to ggplot2::theme_bw().

n

number of colours (at most 8; more are recycled with a warning).

Value

theme_varm(): a ggplot2::theme(); varm_palette(): a character vector of hex colours.

See also

Other plotting: autoplot.varm_draws(), autoplot.varm_forecast(), autoplot.varm_hd(), autoplot.varm_irf()

Examples

varm_palette(3)
#> [1] "#0072B2" "#D55E00" "#009E73"
ggplot2::ggplot(yraw, ggplot2::aes(infl, rate)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(colour = varm_palette(1)) +
  theme_varm()
